[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.1520 → -0.1086) + 개선 진단 + 약세 전환 신호 미약

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($89.55) vs SMA5/20/50($89.75/$90.00/$89.18): positioned below short-term, above mid-term averages
· SMA100/200($89.84/$79.49) comparison: indicating weakening long-term trend strength
· 52-week position (73.9%) + current price range near historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.8 → 49.7) + neutral assessment + slight downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1520 → -0.1086) + improving trend + weak signal for bearish reversal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $90.00) + band width at 7.42% indicating contraction
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($88.30) + based on pivot/swing low
· Swing resistance ($92.14) + potential for uptrend breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + lack of directional trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.80x) + reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase assessment (accumulation) + awaiting conditions for entry/wait-and-see
